text:
maya: hi @acme-ops — seen your ticket, sorry for the login outage. can you confirm this started right after your IdP key rotation?
acme-ops: yep, rolled certs ~10:03UTC. users started getting 403s when hitting our app at ~10:07.
maya: ok. can you share the IdP metadata xml or a link? also a sample SAMLResponse (base64) from a failed attempt would help.
acme-ops: uploading metadata now — https://files.acme/example-idp-metadata.xml :link:
liam: quick note — we often see Destination mismatch when CDNs strip trailing slashes. check the Assertion Destination vs the SP ACS URL.
acme-ops: decoded SAMLResponse shows Destination="https://app.acme.com/sso/consume" but our SP ACS is configured as "https://app.acme.com/sso/consume/" (with trailing slash).
ida: that mismatch will cause the SP to reject the response. SAML spec requires exact match for Destination. can you change SP ACS or request IdP to send the trailing slash?
samir: also noticed the metadata has two <KeyDescriptor use=\"signing\"> entries. after rotation the IdP listed the old key first. our verifier picks the first matching cert for signature validation; if ordering is old->new signatures can fail.
acme-ops: ah — during rotation they uploaded both certs and didn't reorder. the signatures on responses are from the new key though.
liam: can you paste the <Signature> validation error from our logs?
maya: logs: 
```
SAMLResponse signature verification failed: cert thumbprint mismatch (expected: F0:12:34:... got: A3:56:78:...)
SAMLResponse Destination mismatch: expected https://app.acme.com/sso/consume/ got https://app.acme.com/sso/consume
```
acme-ops: weird — thumbprint mismatch and destination mismatch together.
ida: two separate problems then. for immediate mitigation: 1) temporarily relax strict Destination check by allowing both variants in SP config (we can add alias). 2) ask IdP to reorder metadata so the new signing key appears first or remove the old key until fully transitioned. 3) we can accept both cert thumbprints in our tenant config for a short window.
acme-ops: can you apply the thumbprint allowlist change for our tenant? it's blocking SSO-based login for 200+ users.
maya: yes — I can add the extra thumbprint to your tenant config. doing it now.
sso-bot: config-change: added additional idp signing-thumbprint A3:56:78:90 (expires 2026-04-01) to tenant acme-123 by maya at 11:12UTC.
acme-ops: ok after that some users can login, but a few still get 403.
liam: pinging eng-runtime to validate Destination matching logic — ida?
ida: deploying a small change to treat trailing-slash variants as equivalent for Destination match in the handshake path (only when tenant config enables it). will push in ~10m canary.
acme-ops: thanks. also want to understand root cause so we can avoid this on future rotations.
ida: long-term: ask IdP to publish only active key, or use separate metadata endpoint for rotations with clear rollover plan (publish new metadata after rotation complete). we also recommend including both ACS variants in SP metadata if your frontend rewrites URLs via CDN.
maya: summary for ticket: applied temporary thumbprint allowlist, canary toggle for relaxed Destination matching enabled for your tenant, recommended IdP metadata cleanup + stable ACS URL (or CDN passthrough). follow-up: we'll monitor for 24h and revert relaxed checks after you confirm rotation fully settled.
acme-ops: appreciate the quick response, will coordinate with IdP to remove old key and standardize ACS. will report back once done. :thumbsup:
